messages:
cheng: quick heads-up — seeing ~12% p50 regression on mistral-7b-gqa after yesterday's kernel_hint change. perf-bot attached a brief flamegraph. Can people eyeball KV cache fragmentation as a suspect? :eyes:

katie: repost the perf summary? root cause could be batching heuristic + kernel swap. did we change fmha->fused kernel hint?

sam: we flipped kernel_hint to prefer_fmha_v2 for seq<=512 in runtime-config yesterday.

perf-bot: flamegraph summary:
- p50 increased from 42ms -> 47ms (12%)
- token compute time diff points to KV lookup hot paths
- increased device-to-host memcpy spikes around paged-kv eviction
(see attached snippet)

maria: did model param layout change? GQA vs MQA head/kv dims mismatch can fragment paged slabs. What are num_key_value_heads and kv_dim for this build?

sasha: for mistral-7b-gqa we use num_key_value_heads=32, kv_dim=64 (per upstream). RoPE scaling tweak we applied last week multiplies rotary dims and can change alignment. If kv_dim*heads isn't 128-aligned, slab allocator ends up with suboptimal packing.

sam: repro command i ran:
```
./bench/run_infer --model=mistral-7b-gqa --kernel-hint=prefer_fmha_v2 --kv-page-size=8192 --batch-strategy=adaptive --num-threads=8
```

repro-bot: quick bench output (avg of 5): p50=48.3ms, p95=120ms, kv-memcpy spikes @ ~330ms intervals

jack: can we try rollback kernel_hint to prefer_fallback for GQA only? if p50 drops we're confident kernel swap interacts with KV layout. also try kv-page-size=4096 or change slab split threshold.

katie: another idea: adjust the batching heuristic to prefer smaller concurrent batches when paged-kv fragmentation > 20%. That reduces concurrent cache churn.

maria: i'll run an extended sweep overnight: vars: kernel_hint {prefer_fmha_v2,prefer_fallback}, kv_page_size {4k,8k,16k}, slab_split_thr {0.2,0.3,0.4}. Will report numbers.

cheng: thanks — please post the minimal repro and perf logs here. if rollback proves it, we'll push a hotfix gating kernel_hint per-model until allocator patch lands. :thumbsup:
